<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="warm" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F99855"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F97C25"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#373737" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFF2E6"/>
  <rect x="12" y="12" width="366" height="820" rx="40" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- iOS status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="36" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#111214">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="31" x2="326" y2="35" stroke="#111214" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="29" x2="330" y2="35" stroke="#111214" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="27" x2="334" y2="35" stroke="#111214" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="32" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#111214" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="32" x2="349" y2="32" stroke="#111214" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="356" y="26" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#111214" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="358" y="28" width="14" height="7" rx="2" fill="#111214"/>
    <rect x="376" y="29" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#111214"/>
  </g>

  <!-- warm geometric header accents -->
  <polygon points="12,92 92,12 142,12 12,142" fill="#F97316" opacity=".12"/>
  <polygon points="378,12 378,94 296,12" fill="#FDC125" opacity=".16"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="390" r="128" fill="#FFF2E6"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="390" r="103" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- brand mark -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="25" fill="#F97316"/>
    <polygon points="195,157 201,177 222,177 205,189 211,210 195,198 179,210 185,189 168,177 189,177" fill="#FDC125"/>
    <text x="195" y="260" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="800" fill="#111214">daily</text>
    <text x="195" y="284" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#373737">A little inspiration, every day</text>
  </g>

  <!-- centered geometric loading spinner -->
  <g transform="translate(195 390)">
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#FDC125"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#FDC125" transform="rotate(30)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#FED624" transform="rotate(60)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#FED624" transform="rotate(90)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#F8A44C" transform="rotate(120)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#F8A44C" transform="rotate(150)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#F97316" transform="rotate(180)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#F97316" transform="rotate(210)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#F68A1D" transform="rotate(240)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#F68A1D" transform="rotate(270)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#FDC125" transform="rotate(300)"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="-83" width="10" height="28" rx="5" fill="#FDC125" transform="rotate(330)"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="7" fill="#F97316"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="522" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">Getting things ready</text>
  <text x="195" y="548" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#ABB7C2">Your daily inspiration is on its way</text>

  <!-- progress bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="91" y="580" width="208" height="6" rx="3" fill="#F3F3F4"/>
    <rect x="91" y="580" width="122" height="6" rx="3" fill="url(#warm)"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="614" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#F68A1D">Loading your feed…</text>

  <!-- navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <line x1="36" y1="748" x2="354" y2="748" stroke="#F3F3F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g opacity=".48">
      <polygon points="61,770 72,760 83,770 83,783 76,783 76,775 68,775 68,783 61,783" fill="none" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="72" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity=".48">
      <circle cx="137" cy="771" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="143" y1="777" x2="149" y2="783" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="137" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity=".48">
      <polygon points="195,760 198,767 206,768 200,773 202,781 195,777 188,781 190,773 184,768 192,767" fill="#F97316"/>
      <text x="195" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">Daily</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity=".48">
      <circle cx="270" cy="767" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="270" cy="780" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="270" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity=".48">
      <circle cx="327" cy="772" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="327" cy="772" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="327" y1="759" x2="327" y2="762" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="327" y1="782" x2="327" y2="785" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="314" y1="772" x2="317" y2="772" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="337" y1="772" x2="340" y2="772" stroke="#373737" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="327" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="147" y="820" width="96" height="4" rx="2" fill="#111214" opacity=".75"/>
</svg>
